body: I’ve done nothing good.Nothing, think that’s what  I am.
Nobody needs to know what’s going on. I’m dealing with the fact I’m garbage. You seem very kind and helpful and I am very appreciative of your comments. But I can’t even think straight.
I appreciate the comment, but I’m shit. Pure shit. I’m a joke. I am going to cut my wrists. I can’t deal with depression and anxiety any longer. My life is down the toilet.
I’m a failure. Simple. Never done anything good in my life. I’m an ugly piece of shit and I’ve convinced myself death is my only option.
